title: Bridging the Semantic Gap from Natural Language Specifications to RTL with Layered Formal Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.30766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in generating register-transfer level (RTL) code from natural-language specifications, their reliability remains limited on designs with complex control logic and temporal behavior. This stems from a fundamental semantic gap: high-level natural language often leaves implementation-critical details underspecified, forcing LLMs to infer unstated assumptions. This paper presents Layered Formal Guidance, a novel framework that bridges this semantic gap by using formal properties as an intermediate semantic layer between natural-language specifications and RTL generation. Our framework applies formal guidance across three layers: property-driven specification augmentation before generation, property-consistency checking after generation, and counterexample-guided refinement after checking. translated_title: 通过分层形式化引导弥合自然语言规范到RTL的语义鸿沟
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在从自然语言规范生成寄存器传输级（RTL）代码方面已展现出潜力，但在具有复杂控制逻辑和时序行为的设计上，其可靠性仍然有限。这源于一个根本性的语义鸿沟：高层次的自然语言往往使实现关键细节未被充分指定，迫使LLM去推断未明确说明的假设。本文提出了分层形式化引导，这是一种新颖的框架，通过将形式化属性用作自然语言规范与RTL生成之间的中间语义层来弥合这一语义鸿沟。该框架在三个层次上应用形式化引导：生成前的属性驱动规范增强、生成后的属性一致性检查，以及检查后的反例引导精化。在RTLLM基准测试和各种开源IP设计上的实验表明，该框架能够有效提升LLM生成RTL代码的可靠性。
tldr: 提出分层形式化引导框架，将形式化属性作为自然语言规范与RTL生成之间的中间语义层，通过生成前规范增强、生成后一致性检查和反例引导精化三个层次显著提升LLM生成复杂RTL代码的可靠性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Layered Formal Guidance, a framework that bridges the semantic gap between natural-language specifications and RTL generation by using formal properties as an intermediate semantic layer, applying property-driven specification augmentation, property-consistency checking, and counterexample-guided refinement to improve the reliability of LLM-based RTL code generation.
